items.exampleEn: The cat jumped onto the kitchen table.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓跳上了廚房的餐桌。

items.exampleEn: The shop is open every day throughout the year.
items.exampleZh: 這家店一年到頭每天都營業。

items.exampleEn: She does not eat meat, nor does she drink milk.
I asked five friends, but none of them could help.
items.exampleZh: 我問了五個朋友，但沒有一個能幫忙。

items.exampleEn: You will miss the bus unless you leave now.
items.exampleZh: 除非你現在出發，否則會錯過公車。

items.exampleEn: Take an umbrella, otherwise you will get wet.
items.exampleZh: 帶把傘吧，不然你會淋濕。

items.exampleEn: I lost my key, but somehow I got into the house.
items.exampleZh: 我弄丟了鑰匙，但不知怎麼還是進了家門。

items.exampleEn: He walked back and forth while he waited.
items.exampleZh: 他一邊等一邊走來走去（back and forth＝來回）。

items.exampleEn: I cooked dinner. Meanwhile, my brother set the table.
items.exampleZh: 我在煮晚餐，這時我弟弟在擺餐具。

items.sentenceEn: You are not allowed in the room unless you have a ticket.
items.sentenceZh: 除非你有票，否則不能進入那個房間。

items.audioEn: Rachel called three shops, but none of them had the book she wanted.
items.audioZh: Rachel 打電話問了三間店，但沒有一間有她想要的書。
items.questionZh: Rachel 找到她想要的書了嗎？
options: No, she called only one shop.
Yes, one of the three shops had it.
No, she couldn't get it from any shop.

items.sentenceEn: The music festival is popular throughout the country.
items.sentenceZh: 這個音樂節在全國都很受歡迎。

items.sentenceEn: Please put your bags onto the shelf.
items.sentenceZh: 請把你們的包包放到架子上。

items.stemEn: Wear a warm coat, ____ you will catch a cold.
items.stemZh: 穿件保暖的外套，不然你會感冒。

items.stemEn: He did not call me, ____ did he send a message.
items.stemZh: 他沒有打電話給我，也沒有傳訊息。

items.passageEn: Mark moved to a new apartment last week. Throughout the day, he carried boxes back and forth. None of his friends were free, so he did everything alone. Meanwhile, his sister was cooking dinner for him at her place. By the evening, Mark was very tired, but somehow he still put all the books onto the shelves. He said he would not move again unless he really had to.
items.passageZh: Mark 上週搬進新公寓。一整天他都在來回搬箱子。他的朋友都沒空，所以他一個人做完所有事。這段時間，他姊姊正在自己家幫他煮晚餐。到了晚上，Mark 已經非常累，但不知怎麼地，他還是把所有書都放上了書架。他說除非真的不得已，不然不會再搬家了。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼 Mark 一個人搬家？
Mark 搬家時，他姊姊在做什麼？

items.promptZh: 除非明天下雨，否則我們會去爬山。
referenceEn: We will go hiking tomorrow unless it rains.
Unless it rains tomorrow, we will go hiking.
rubricZh: unless 句用現在式表示未來（it rains）
主要句用表示未來的寫法（例如 will）

items.promptZh: 火車晚了一個小時。在這期間，我們在車站喝了咖啡。
referenceEn: The train was an hour late. Meanwhile, we had coffee at the station.
The train was one hour late. Meanwhile, we drank some coffee in the station.
rubricZh: 用 meanwhile 表示「在這期間」（例如 Meanwhile, we…；寫 In the meantime 也正確）
「喝了咖啡」可寫，例如 had coffee、drank some coffee 等；時態配合過去的事（例如 was、had 等）
